title: Google gives CEO new pay deal worth up to $692 million
title_zh: 谷歌为首席执行官提供价值高达 6.92 亿美元的新薪酬协议
summary: The CEO of Google and its parent company Alphabet could earn up to $692 million over the next three years under a new compensation plan published Friday by the US Securities and Exchange Commission.Under the plan, Pichai's three-year salary of $6 million, or $2 million per yea...
summary_zh: 根据美国证券交易委员会周五公布的一项新薪酬计划，谷歌及其母公司 Alphabet 的首席执行官未来三年的收入最高可达 6.92 亿美元。根据该计划，皮查伊的三年薪水为 600 万美元，即每年 200 万美元。

title: Applied Digital Ties AI Growth To Oracle Lease And Power Deal
title_zh: Applied Digital 将人工智能增长与 Oracle 租赁和电力交易联系起来
summary: Applied Digital (NasdaqGS:APLD) completed a secured note offering of about US$2.15b to fund its Polaris Forge 2 AI data center campus in North Dakota. The Polaris Forge 2 facility is planned as a 200MW AI data center, pre-leased to Oracle under a long-term agreement.
summary_zh: Applied Digital（纳斯达克股票代码：APLD）完成了约 2.15 亿美元的担保票据发行，为其位于北达科他州的 Polaris Forge 2 人工智能数据中心园区提供资金。 Polaris Forge 2 设施规划为 200MW 人工智能数据中心，根据长期协议...

title: The Dealmaking 3: Wicket Makes Canadian Deal, F1’s Latest Deal with Apple, F1 Q4 Earnings
title_zh: 交易 3：Wicket 达成加拿大交易、F1 与苹果的最新交易、F1 第四季度收益
summary: Watch The Dealmaking 3 of the Week: This week of The Dealmaking 3 with “The Sports Professor” Rick Horrow features the Calgary Flames becoming Wicket’s first Canadian customer with VIP facial recognition for ticketing deployment, Apple Inc.
summary_zh: 观看本周的《交易 3》：本周《体育教授》里克·霍罗 (Rick Horrow) 主持的《交易 3》中，卡尔加里火焰队 (Calgary Flames) 成为 Wicket 首个采用 VIP 面部识别技术进行票务部署的加拿大客户，苹果公司 (Apple Inc.)

title: Blackstone, Ares Back $5 Billion Financing for Thoma Bravo's WWEX-Auctane Merger
title_zh: Blackstone 和 Ares 为 Thoma Bravo 的 WWEX-Auctane 合并提供 50 亿美元融资
summary: Private credit lenders fund Thoma Bravo's logistics-software tie-up, valuing the combined WWEX and Auctane business at about $11.6 billion.
summary_zh: 私人信贷机构为 Thoma Bravo 的物流软件合作提供资金，对 WWEX 和 Auctane 业务的合并估值约为 116 亿美元。

title: New Mountain Ends Talks on Former Executive's $32 Billion Buyout Plan
title_zh: New Mountain 结束关于前高管 320 亿美元收购计划的谈判
summary: Private equity firm halted negotiations with Matt Holt over proposal to acquire five healthcare technology portfolio companies.
summary_zh: 私募股权公司停止与马特·霍尔特就收购五家医疗保健技术投资组合公司的提议进行谈判。
